column1: # Acquired-resistance mutations detectable in plasma ctDNA, used by serial_ctdna.py to annotate the variants of
# patients with serial plasma samples. Research use only.
# therapy: classes from therapy_classes.tsv (";" between several). When the patient's treatments are known
# (treatments.tsv, see clinical_timeline.py), a match is flagged only if the patient received a treatment of one of
# these classes before the sample; otherwise each match only says which therapy it is a known resistance
# Only variants named in each paper's abstract (checked against PubMed, DOI and PMID below) are listed.
# hotspots: protein changes/positions matched against HGVSp_Short (G12 matches p.G12D, p.G12V...).
# classes: any / truncating / missense; empty = hotspots only. exons: restrict classes to these exons.
# only_new: yes = flagged only when the variant is new in a later plasma sample (not at baseline), for mutations
# that are also common at diagnosis (e.g. KRAS hotspots) or patient-specific (BRCA reversions).
# Left out on purpose: NRAS under anti-EGFR antibodies, the other EGFR ectodomain mutations (Arena 2015), ESR1 L536
# and E380Q, other ALK mutations, NTRK3 G623R, FGFR2 secondary mutations other than V564F, AR W742C/H875Y, KIT
# secondary mutations: the variant lists couldn't be checked in the sources. PIK3CA: no secondary-mutation
# resistance reported for alpelisib (Razavi 2020 Nat Cancer doi:10.1038/s43018-020-0047-1 reports PTEN loss, ESR1).
